about: Every mod The Curse of Alduin plays with in your game, read from your plugins and SKSE folder. Updated Nov 26 from your picks: 20 plugins turned off (a copy of your old Plugins.txt is kept as Plugins.txt.before-modstack-nov26), the make-our-own work started, two questions left in Decisions (grass, the High Fantasy pack). Your pick shows on each; change any of them here.
